items.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: I think “Bitches Brew” is but a platinum record, I got a platinum record for that one called “Innocent Age.”

ctx.x: Right. Of the Pop people, sometimes it’s hard to make a distinction but of the Pop artists you’ve worked with, who have you enjoyed the most?

Joni Mitchell, great band. Dan Fogelberg. That’s my only — oh no that’s not the only one — I think “Bitches Brew” is but a platinum record, I got a platinum record for that one called “Innocent Age.” And Ian Hunter — me and Jaco did him. English.
